title: Executable doesn't exist at /ms-playwright/chromium-XXXX inside the official Playwright Docker image
symptoms: Looks like Playwright was just installed or updated.
Tests pass locally and fail in CI the day a new @playwright/test version lands
cause: Each Playwright release expects one exact browser build number, and the image only ships the builds for its own tag. A caret range in package.json or a floating image tag lets the npm package and the image drift apart.
fix: Pin @playwright/test to an exact version and use the image tag with the same version. Upgrade both in one commit.
affected: All Playwright versions using mcr.microsoft.com/playwright images; browser build numbers change with most minor releases
